t: The Brackenheath iSpot Deco is a decorative cube wall light designed to provide automatic security lighting for indoor and outdoor areas. This mains-powered fixture is ideal for domestic porches, pathways, and commercial building entrances. Constructed with a robust IP65 polycarbonate body and diffuser, it offers long-lasting durability in all weather conditions. The integrated 180° PIR and photocell sensor detects movement up to 10 metres away, while an adjustable dusk-to-dawn sensor ensures efficient operation. A fast-fix backplate enables quick installation, and the unit supports 1 x G9 bulb up to 9W. This PIR unit can control up to 8 fittings (max. 150W LED load) when linked in series.
b: Flexible 3-in-1 Control Offers Manual Override Option
